preconditions: No arguments. Safe to call repeatedly — existing slugs are left untouched.

description: Seeds the 9 canonical default categories (Food & Dining, Transport, Utilities, Shopping, Entertainment, Healthcare, Travel, Office & Supplies, Other) into your tenant, skipping any slug that already exists. Takes no arguments and is safe to call repeatedly or concurrently — it converges rather than duplicating. NEXT: expense_category_list to see the result.
name: expense_category_ensure_defaults
